## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link the issue; use `Closes #...` only if this PR completes its acceptance criteria.

## Verification

List the commands or manual checks performed, their results, and any exclusions. Add screenshots for visual changes.

## Release and operations

Describe any migration, configuration, dependency, deployment, or rollback requirements and known limitations. Write “None” if there are no special requirements.

## Checklist

- [ ] The scope and acceptance criteria are clear, and related issues are linked.
- [ ] Relevant checks passed; skipped or unrun checks and residual risks are stated above.
- [ ] Documentation is updated where behavior or maintenance steps changed.
- [ ] The diff and evidence contain no credentials, personal data, or production test fixtures.
- [ ] Any database or external-service tests used an isolated, authorized test environment.
